summary.text: Dragon Offspring is Duke Long's immortal killer move.

claims.text: At the immortal graveyard, after Fang Yuan’s triple layered sword wave cuts sleeping Heavenly Court Gu Immortals, Duke Long roars this move in fury. His purple dragon scales fly out, mix with his blood, and transform into dragonman Gu Immortals of all shapes and sizes, with all kinds of appearances. There are rank six, rank seven, and even rank eight dragonmen. Duke Long is not an enslavement path Gu Immortal, but he has a similar killer move. Fang Yuan names it a transformation path killer move that contains human path profundity.

Fang Yuan accuses him of massacring the dragonman race in order to refine them into a killer move, killing his children and grandchildren and refining them into puppets. Duke Long does not refute the accusation. Deep sadness shows in his eyes as he charges again. The dragonman Gu Immortals spread like a blooming flower, blocking the sword waves and countless year beasts.

Duke Long’s dragon offspring killer move was indeed using members of the dragonman race, and Fang Yuan’s accusation was not false. Duke Long rarely used this move, and was forced to use it then because of Fang Yuan.

Many dragonman Gu Immortals surround Fang Yuan’s immemorial sword dragon. Fang Yuan activates golden thread sword. Golden threads pierce the encircling dragonman Gu Immortals. They cannot keep their shape, detonate softly, and return to scales and blood droplets.

Purple dragon scales fly out of Duke Long, mix with his blood, and become dragonman Gu Immortals of all shapes, sizes, and appearances, including rank six, rank seven, and rank eight. When destroyed, they return to scales and blood droplets.
In Duke Long’s transformation path combat system, dragon offspring makes up for the lack of capability to fight a group. The strongest method in that system is heavenly dragon’s last stand.
